body:
Founder asked whether not being able to switch a mannequin's attached animation was intentional -- confirmed no, real frontend bug: the Attach panel button only rendered when a row had no animation yet, even though AttachAnimation itself (a plain UPDATE) always supported re-attaching. Fixed: button now always available on mesh/rig rows, relabeled Switch animation when one exists. Second fix same thread: founder noted characters and bare motion clips were mixed in one flat list, confusing after multi-clip import started creating dozens of clip rows per upload -- added Characters vs Motion clips filter views, Characters as the new default. tsc/build clean, redeployed. Commit 9222d03.

⚓ ☃
title: NOCK: fix animation-switching visibility bug + separate Characters/Motion clips views
